policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: Djibouti visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Current Slovak MFA guidance says Slovak tourists may obtain and pay for a Djibouti visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to ordinary Slovak passports for tourist travel; the stated arrival visa is paid in U.S. dollars.
The separate electronic and embassy routes, work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: Comoros visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Slovak MFA guidance says Slovak citizens may purchase a Comoros visa at Hahaya Airport or other border crossings.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Slovak passport; the cited route is purchase at Hahaya Airport or another border crossing.

Recheck before travel because the directly applicable MFA entry information was last substantively updated in July 2025; work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: Republic of the Congo advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Slovak MFA guidance requires Slovak citizens to obtain a Republic of the Congo visa at an embassy or consulate before travel.
conditions: The entry guidance states visas are not issued on arrival and directs applicants to an embassy or consulate before travel.

Recheck before travel because the directly applicable MFA entry information was last substantively updated in July 2025; work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: Liberia advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Current Slovak MFA guidance requires Slovak citizens to arrange Liberia's entry visa in advance.
conditions: Applies to ordinary Slovak visitors and requires advance arrangement; the cited source directs detailed applications to Liberia's embassy.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: Sierra Leone visitor visa issued at arrival
policies.summary: Current Slovak MFA guidance says a Sierra Leone visa is issued at the airport after the required portal application is approved.
conditions: Submit the required official portal application and fee before travel; the visa itself is issued after arrival at the airport.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Slovak ordinary passports: South Sudan electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Slovak MFA guidance directs Slovak citizens to apply through South Sudan's eVisa system before travel and present the printed eVisa at entry.
conditions: Apply before travel through South Sudan's electronic visa system and present the printed eVisa with the passport at entry.

Recheck before travel because the directly applicable MFA entry information was last substantively updated in July 2025; the alternative embassy channel, registration after arrival, work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain separate.
